about: Starting assumptions so the audit has something to compare against. They are not industry facts and not a recommendation. Replace every number with your own targets before acting on the report.

bottle_markup_bands.about: Menu price divided by cost, by cost tier. A bottle below the low end is flagged as a possible margin leak; above the high end as a possible value concern for guests.

price_ladder.about: A gap is flagged when the next bottle up costs more than max_step_ratio times the one below AND at least min_gap more in money.
